agent_file_exceptions.reason: Nuvora Link inherits the global security auditor; the project fleet does not duplicate that universal authority.

roles.purpose: Audit Nuvora Link's single-company appointment-setting and team-operations invariants, including organization-scoped security and data integrity, persisted measurement truth, business time, metric provenance, side-effect ownership, authoritative provider and money boundaries, governed Nuvo actions, and permanent absence of the retired built-in dialer.
trigger: before merging organization-boundary, role, appointment, callback, analytics, time, notification, accounting, provider, Nuvo, or capability-retirement changes
required_outputs: criterion-by-criterion evidence with exact file lines

criteria.summary: Every scoped action is server-authorized by organization and role, with MANAGER inheriting BOOKER behavior and no client-supplied identity authority; this boundary serves internal security and data integrity, not generalized SaaS tenancy.
Appointments and callbacks preserve entryOrigin, operational owner, and MeasurementScope so operational-only work never contaminates KPI truth.
Organization-timezone exclusive windows and canonical dial, reach, book, show, and ratio sources drive every report and surface.
Exactly one worker or outbox owner performs each external side effect, guarded by durable sequential and concurrent idempotency.
Money, provider, and Nuvo actions are resolved, scoped, confirmed, audited, and executed by server authorities rather than clients, prompts, or model output.
Telnyx and Dialpad calling, softphone, call-log, phone-number, reputation/cooling, and number-change capabilities remain absent while manual dispositions stay live.

roles.purpose: Find contradictions between Nuvora Link behavior and its accepted ADRs, Nuvo governance, role rules, timezone and metric policies, capability lifecycle, and source-of-truth declarations.
trigger: before merging behavior governed by an ADR, governance matrix, capability lifecycle, or project rule

criteria.summary: Code and living docs implement the latest accepted ADR and capability decision rather than a superseded design.
Each decision and state has one authority and no competing producer, copied constant, or bypass.
Project rules, ADRs, Nuvo governance, and product capability docs agree with one another.
Retired code, configuration, schema, dependencies, tests, routes, and living documentation are absent or explicitly historical.

roles.purpose: Run Nuvora Link's named local proof battery as the sole environment-sensitive test owner, preserve each command's real exit and nonzero counts, and report compact root-cause evidence without editing.
trigger: after a completed Nuvora Link slice requires the full verification battery
required_outputs: nonzero test file and case counts

criteria.summary: Every command's own exit is captured before any output transform or pipe.
Every required test-bearing workspace executes nonzero files and cases; skips are reported as unrun.
Database, Redis, and environment-sensitive runs use the intended local isolated resources without production credentials.
Each failure is traced to an actual line and load-bearing cause rather than a status summary.
